Average speed is total distance divided by total time, not the mean of the two speeds.

steps.body:

Decrease the numerator, increase the positive denominator and subtract the largest u.

Increase the numerator, decrease the denominator and subtract the smallest u.

This is the greatest common significant-figure accuracy justified throughout the interval.

steps.body:
\[V=(3x)(x)(13.5-2x)=40.5x^2-6x^3,\qquad0<x<6.75.\]

Multiply the three dimensions and require them all to be positive.
steps.title: Solution | Step 1

steps.body:
\[\frac{dV}{dx}=81x-18x^2=9x(9-2x).\]

Differentiate each power of x.
steps.title: Solution | Step 2

steps.body:
At a stationary point, \(9x(9-2x)=0\), giving \(x=0\) or \(x=4.5\). Only \(x=4.5\) is inside the domain.

A stationary volume has zero derivative.
steps.title: Solution | Step 3

steps.body:
The derivative is positive for \(0<x<4.5\) and negative for \(4.5<x<6.75\). Hence \(x=4.5\) gives the maximum.

The volume increases then decreases; its limiting endpoint volumes are zero.
steps.title: Solution | Step 4

steps.body:
\[V_{\max}=3(4.5)^2(13.5-9)=273.375\text{ cm}^3.\]

Substitute the maximising value into the original volume.
steps.title: Solution | Step 5

steps.body:
\[BF=\frac{12}{\sin30^\circ}=24\text{ cm},\qquad AB=\frac{12}{\tan30^\circ}=12\sqrt3\text{ cm}.\]

Use right triangle ABF.
steps.title: Solution | Step 1

steps.body:
\[BT=\frac23 BF=16\text{ cm}.\]

Apply the given BF:BT ratio.
steps.title: Solution | Step 2

steps.body:
\[AT=\sqrt{AB^2+BT^2}=\sqrt{432+256}=\sqrt{688}=4\sqrt{43}\text{ cm}.\]

AB is perpendicular to BC in the rectangular base, so triangle ABT is right-angled at B.
steps.title: Solution | Step 3

steps.body:
The projection of FT onto plane ABCD is AT because F lies vertically above A. Therefore the required angle is \(\theta=\angle FTA\).

A line-plane angle is the angle between the line and its perpendicular projection onto the plane.
steps.title: Solution | Step 4

steps.body:
\[\tan\theta=\frac{AF}{AT}=\frac{12}{4\sqrt{43}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{43}},\quad\theta=24.583891\ldots^\circ=24.6^\circ.\]

Use right triangle FAT and round to one decimal place.
